DEC-002.title: preemption: promote partial victim loss to whole-sequence recompute
DEC-002.rationale: A sequence's block table is positional (block i <-> tokens i*BLOCK_SIZE..); interior removal shifts every later position onto the wrong physical block and silently corrupts attention, while num_computed_tokens overstates intact KV. Whole-sequence recompute reuses the proven Phase-2 recovery path and keeps priority-weighted victim ranking.
alternatives_rejected: suffix-only eviction + num_computed_tokens/tokens truncation (partial recompute: complex, needs model-layer coordination, no test coverage)
exclude running-sequence blocks from victims entirely (makes Phase 1 a no-op after prefix-cache drain; loses priority-weighted selection)

DEC-003.title: RIL consistency check: orphan audit records are not problems
DEC-003.rationale: Evidence and decisions are append-only audit trail; a baseline observation (e.g. 'clippy green on day X') needs no edge to be valuable. Flagging them as orphans pressures agents to invent semantically-empty edges, which the typed-edge rule forbids. Work-bearing types (issue/hypothesis/task/change) remain flagged.
alternatives_rejected: force every evidence node to attach to a hypothesis (fabricates edges, violates no-untyped-edge spirit)
drop consistency check entirely (loses cycle/dangling detection)

EV-009.title: RadixTree::insert overwrites node.blocks without returning/releasing the previous entry: re-completing a prompt that hit the prefix cache records a new cache ref (refcount +1) while the old cache ref is orphaned -> refcount inflates on every repeat completion; inflated blocks never reach <=1 so select_victims skips them and drain_blocks releases only one ref, leaving the block pinned forever (pool exhaustion under repeated-prompt workloads). Also entry_count increments on overwrite so len() overcounts.

EV-010.title: MemoryManager::rollback slices seq.kv_blocks[blocks_after..blocks_before] with bounds derived from num_computed_tokens; update_sequences increments num_computed_tokens BEFORE the allocation loop and silently breaks on OOM, so kv_blocks.len() can be < blocks_before -> out-of-range slice panic on a later draft rollback

ISS-003.title: prefix cache re-insert leaks cache refcounts (repeated prompts pin blocks, drain cannot reclaim)

ISS-004.title: rollback panics on OOM-shortened kv_blocks (slice bounds from num_computed_tokens)
